answer: In a PoA network, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, and equivocation evidence links signatures, timing, and stake provenance. For k correlated identities, the penalty grows quadratically, O(k^2), so coordinated false histories rapidly exhaust shared backing; upon detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier applies to the sybil swarm through asymmetric depreciation. Thus an oasis, jade, or ripple-themed identity set gains no cheap plurality: splitting control only magnifies slash exposure.
